description: The desired state of a table. Leave a property out to keep it as it is. Nothing left out is removed.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the changes go into. Its publisher decides the prefix.

table.description: The table. schemaName finds it; a new table needs displayName and pluralName.

schemaName.description: Schema name, for example con_Project. A new table needs the publisher prefix.

ownership.description: Fixed when the table is created. Default user.

primaryName.description: The primary name column. Fixed when the table is created, apart from its label and length.

notes.description: Notes and attachments. Cannot be turned off once on.

activities.description: Activities can be regarding this table. Cannot be turned off once on.

columns.description: Columns to create or update, in order. Columns not listed are kept.

items.description: A column. schemaName finds it; its type cannot change once created.

schemaName.description: Schema name, for example con_Budget. A new column needs the publisher prefix.

precision.description: Decimal places. decimal 0 to 10, float 0 to 5, money 0 to 4 (default: the currency's).

behavior.description: datetime and dateonly. New columns default to userLocal for datetime and dateOnly for dateonly. Can change only from userLocal, once; left out, an existing column keeps its behavior.

options.description: choice and multichoice: the column's own options. Existing options not listed are kept.

items.description: An option. value finds it; without value the label does, and a new option gets the next value from the publisher's option prefix.

globalChoice.description: choice and multichoice: the name of an existing global choice, instead of options.

target.description: lookup only: the logical name of the table it points to. Fixed once created.

relationshipName.description: lookup only: the relationship's schema name. Default <prefix>_<target>_<table>_<column>.

maxSizeInKb.description: file only: maximum size in KB, 1 to 10485760 (default 32768). Fixed once created.

manyToMany.description: Many-to-many relationships between this table and another.

items.description: A many-to-many relationship. schemaName finds it.

schemaName.description: Schema name with the publisher prefix. It also names the intersect table.

table.description: Logical name of the other table. Fixed once created.

keys.description: Alternate keys. Apply waits until the key's index is active.

items.description: An alternate key. schemaName finds it; its columns are fixed once created.

schemaName.description: Schema name with the publisher prefix.

columns.description: Logical names of the key's columns.
